pages.text: In my explorations below the ground, some materials still elude me. Perhaps they are different in this world. An idea struck me for tools I have never needed before, but which may prove useful.$(br2)A $(item)Sieve$() should let me work through loose earth and sand. A shallow $(item)Gold Pan$() should separate heavy flakes from river sediment.

The shapes are clear in my mind, but the exact measurements are not. I will leave space here for proper crafting diagrams once I have settled the materials.$(br2)For now, I know only their purposes: the Sieve should separate useful fragments from common earth, while the Gold Pan should recover heavy material from moving water.
